text:
maya: quick RFC — proposing a tiny companion gem `redwood-cli` for local dev. it would handle `redwood login`, `redwood proxy` (local proxy to hosted API for testing), and a couple of convenience commands. want quick feedback on credential storage strategy. the initial impl stores token in `~/.config/redwood/credentials` (yaml) for simplicity.

sam: +1 for a CLI. question: plaintext YAML ok? security concerns if people have shared machines. :thinking_face:

liam: we should integrate with OS keyring (macOS keychain, Windows credential manager, Linux SecretService). there are gems we can wrap rather than inventing our own. fallback to file only if keyring unavailable.

maya: thanks — thinking precedence: 1) env var 2) OS keyring 3) config file. sample precedence in code: 

```
# pseudo
TOKEN = ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY'] || Keyring.get('redwood') || YAML.load(File.read(path))['api_key']
```

eva: also consider `--host` flag to point to Dedicated/Private endpoints and a `--service-account` flow. docs will need to show token rotation / refresh flow for long-lived tokens.

sam: small nit — avoid writing full token to disk by default. prompt the user and only save if they explicitly agree. for encryption we can offer libsodium-based opt-in.

maya: what about default UX: prompt to save if no keyring present? "Save to disk for convenience? (y/N)". no auto-save. also add `redwood logout` to clear stored creds.

liam: CI/automation workflows will need file-based creds. keep support for file-based creds for CI with restricted perms. add a note in README about perms (chmod 600).

ci-bot: :robot_face: CI alert — integration tests for CLI are flaking on Windows runners due to a `homebrew`-install step in the matrix. opened issue #412 with logs: https://ci.example.com/1234/logs

maya: @sam @liam can one of you glance at PR #234 that has the proof-of-concept? it's mostly CLI + keyring shim. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/234

sam: I'll take a look tomorrow. quick scan: LGTM but add an integration test mocking keyring and a unit for fallback order. :+1:

eva: also add a short 'local-proxy' example in sample-apps showing how to record requests for offline tests (like `redwood proxy --record`). that will help platform teams replicate Hosted behavior.

maya: thanks all. leaving this open for more comments, will update PR to use keyring fallback, explicit opt-in save, and CI fixes.

liam: one more: consider adding `--config-dir` env var for alternate paths so projects or infra can pin creds in ephemeral containers.

maya: noted. I'll update the README and the PR description. thanks! :sparkles:
